name: Choco Chip Cookies
ingredients: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Sugar, Choco Chips (22%) [Sugar, Edible Vegetable Fat, Cocoa Solids, Dextrose, Emulsifiers (INS 322 from Soy, INS 476), Nature Identical & Artificial Flavouring Substances (Vanilla, Chocolate)], Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm), Desiccated Coconut Powder, Milk Solids, Butter, Leavening Agents (INS 500 ii, INS 503 ii), lodised Salt, Emulsifier (INS 322 from Soy), Natural, Nature Identical & Artificial Flavouring Substances (Butter, Vanillin, Chocolate). Allergen Advice: Contains Wheat, Milk and Soy. May contain traces of Nut
